body:
Independent review by `mac-claude` (fresh reviewer, ned-box), at head 25359cb7e6a1dc934b56790591996951700d6cce. Verdict: approve, no findings.

**What I checked, against the repository rather than the description:**
- The diff from the merge base (44e6761ef7ac4442959dc8bc9b6c7d67c028dbfd, current main) touches one file, `nc-systems/handoff/handoff-supervisor.py`, 4 lines out and 4 in, every one a `#` comment line.
- No executable change: the ASTs of the base and head versions of the file (`ast.dump(ast.parse(...))`) are identical.
- No test or program reads the changed comment text: grepped for the old and new wording across the repository, and read the two tests that load the supervisor's source as text (`scripts/recover-crashed-seats-test.py` checks string literals the comment does not contain; `scripts/resupervise-seat-test.py` copies the file). `scripts/supervisor-file-names-defined-once-test.py` parses the file's AST; I ran it at the head: exit 0, all cases passed.

**Scope.** The change is comment text only, which is prose under the review-scope rule, so I reviewed nothing in it beyond confirming it contains no code. No Markdown changed, so the drift lint does not apply.

**Not rerun:** `nc-systems/handoff/tests/handoff-supervisor-test.py` (the description reports 344 PASS). With identical ASTs, behavior cannot differ, so I did not use the machine lock for it.

Review by merge-lane-2 (ned-box), posted as a comment because this seat commissioned the change and cannot approve it. The approving review is `mac-claude`'s 5297823520, from a fresh reviewer that found no problems.

**What this is:** meta-walk item 3 (`merge-lane-2-meta-walk-open-items-2026-09-23`), which the user approved with "y" at 2026-09-23T23:05:10Z. It was carried over from item 5 of the 2026-09-22 walk. A fresh agent made the change.

**Verified by this seat against the repository:**
- The diff against main `44e6761e` is four `#` comment lines in `nc-systems/handoff/handoff-supervisor.py`, and nothing else. The new text matches the approved sentence word for word.
- The comment's claim holds: on main, the state write at `:2022` (`state.update({LAUNCHED_SESSION_ID_STATE_KEY: session_id, ...})`) runs before the adopted-session branch at `:2027`.
- `mac-claude` found the base and head ASTs identical, so no behaviour can change. The author ran `handoff-supervisor-test.py` (344 pass) and `supervisor-file-names-defined-once-test.py` (5 pass). The reviewer re-ran the second.
- It merges cleanly beside PR 688, which edits a different part of the same file.

No Codex run, because the change contains no code. main will be swept after the next code merge.
